messages.subject: Questions about datepicker
parts:
Hi everyone,
I have some questions about datepicker.
What I am doing is to show the energy consumption over time. Date picker can help the users to choose the start date and end date, and then the plot of the energy consumption during these time will come out.
I have two questions:
1. I found resources about datepicker here, http://www.eyecon.ro/bootstrap-datepicker/. I like the way below the text 'Attached to other elment then field and using events to work with the date values.'
I download the datepicker.zip, but I don't know how to apply it to Shiny.

2. Because I want to have different plots indicating energy consumption in days, months and years, the date the user inputs should have a comparison with the date in the existing dataset and thus there will be energy consumption data.
What's the variable name for the date, month, year in the date picker which I can use in Shiny?

Thank you for your help.
Best wishes,
Oliver
